nodes.title: Verified startup
nodes.summary: Startup and migration status is checked before navigation.

nodes.title: Startup / migration failure
nodes.summary: No destructive reset; verified local data is retained.

nodes.title: Local-first onboarding
nodes.summary: Account-free introduction; optional Voice education is not a prerequisite.

nodes.title: Six-command education
nodes.summary: The optional tutorial explains six deterministic English intents.

nodes.title: Local-media permission rationale
nodes.summary: User-controlled request. Android—not the app—owns the resulting dialog.

nodes.title: Android media permission boundary
nodes.summary: Platform-native permission dialog deliberately NOT rendered. Select an OS result in the external simulator.

nodes.title: Media access unavailable
nodes.summary: Manual fallback remains available; no false claim of library readiness.

nodes.title: Permanent media denial
nodes.summary: An explicit Settings handoff is available outside Driving.

nodes.title: Android Settings boundary
nodes.summary: The native Settings page is Android-owned. App returns and rechecks media permission.

nodes.title: Media access granted
nodes.summary: The actual platform grant is used; proceed to local MediaStore scan.

nodes.title: Scanning local music
nodes.summary: MediaStore/index state is observed, not fabricated.

nodes.title: Recoverable scan error
nodes.summary: Keep last verified library state; retry only on explicit action.

nodes.title: Verified empty library
nodes.summary: No accessible audio found. This is not a permission-denied state.

nodes.title: Ready Library
nodes.summary: Songs, Artists, Albums and Folders are the existing manual browse categories.

nodes.title: Local Search / empty query
nodes.summary: Search is strictly local. The sample query and results are synthetic.

nodes.title: Local Search results
nodes.summary: Only the selected visible collection can be submitted to the one MediaSessionService.

nodes.title: Search: no results
nodes.summary: Preserve query; no online-catalog fallback.

edges.label: Edit query and find local results

nodes.title: Search error
nodes.summary: The verified library remains available and the entered query is preserved.

nodes.title: Stale selection
nodes.summary: Re-read MediaStore/access; never play a vanished item or replace prior service queue.

nodes.title: Queue start pending
nodes.summary: This is a reviewer annotation of the pending selected-collection handoff; no new loading screen.

nodes.title: Full Player — Playing
nodes.summary: Playback truth belongs to the single service-owned MediaSession.

nodes.title: Full Player — Paused
nodes.summary: Manual play only; no automatic restart.

nodes.title: Current service queue
nodes.summary: Queue view is within the already-approved Player owner and visible source collection.

nodes.title: Corrupt / inaccessible media
nodes.summary: Bounded forward skip/reconcile; no delete, shuffle, wrap or fabricated online match.

nodes.title: Controller reconnect
nodes.summary: UI does not construct another player; it waits for complete service snapshot.

edges.label: Service unavailable; no valid P1 restore

nodes.title: Android active-session ownership handoff
nodes.summary: Service continues outside UI; Android owns lifecycle and native controls.

nodes.title: App background: native lifecycle
nodes.summary: App UI absent; the MediaSessionService remains sole playback owner.

nodes.title: Screen off / lock screen
nodes.summary: Android owns the system lock-screen UI. Playback continues only while the actual service/route is active.

edges.label: Return to app and read actual snapshot

nodes.title: Native lock-screen MediaSession controller
nodes.summary: Android owns the lock-screen artwork/actions; no app-defined screen or Android Auto UI.

nodes.title: External headset / vehicle media key
nodes.summary: External compatible media keys are Android-dispatched to the same MediaSession.

nodes.title: OEM/service lifecycle check
nodes.summary: An OEM may terminate the active session; NEVER pretend playback survived.

edges.label: Service lost; valid P1 snapshot restores Paused
Service lost; no verified snapshot → Home

nodes.title: Native MediaSession controls
nodes.summary: Android owns notification, lock-screen and vehicle media-key surfaces. No mock system UI.

nodes.title: System command awaiting service
nodes.summary: Android/controller command is pending; no UI-owned optimistic status.

nodes.title: Notification unavailable
nodes.summary: Android may hide the system controller; music/player remain truthful and manually controllable.

edges.label: Use explicit OS Settings outside Driving

nodes.title: Notification permission/visibility boundary
nodes.summary: An Android-owned notification-setting handoff. No in-app imitation.

nodes.title: P1 Paused Restore
nodes.summary: Only validated persisted snapshot may restore an explicitly Paused state. This does not imply live P0 continuity.

edges.label: User explicitly requests Play; revalidate item

nodes.title: Driving — Playing
nodes.summary: Manual entry only; immediate Exit; no keyboard, Queue, Search or Settings.

nodes.title: Driving — Paused
nodes.summary: Service-confirmed Paused. No automatic playback.

nodes.title: Driving — No Track
nodes.summary: No unverified active Play last. Disabled transport remains inert.

nodes.title: Driving — verified Play last
nodes.summary: Conditional same-state approved action. Verified local MediaStore identity first.

nodes.title: Driving — Safe Paused
nodes.summary: Platform route/focus handoff stays Android/System-owned; UI shows only actual safe paused state.

nodes.title: Voice — Listening
nodes.summary: Explicit mic tap begins one bounded six-second capture. Simulated speech is selected from reviewer panel.

nodes.title: Voice — final attempt
nodes.summary: Explicit Retry consumed; no third attempt.

nodes.title: Voice — Processing
nodes.summary: Restricted deterministic six-intent mapping; no command is approximated.

nodes.title: Voice — Confirming one candidate
nodes.summary: Only immutable option 1 + Neither / Cancel, no new question.

nodes.title: Voice — Confirming two candidates
nodes.summary: Exactly two immutable labels. No second confirmation.

nodes.title: Voice — awaiting playback ack
nodes.summary: Command success follows only service acknowledgement.

nodes.title: Voice — Executed
nodes.summary: TTS <=1 sentence; a TTS failure cannot revoke acknowledged command success.

nodes.title: Voice — successful, TTS unavailable
nodes.summary: Same Executed surface and service state; optional spoken feedback fails non-fatally.

nodes.title: Voice — first STT timeout
nodes.summary: Exactly one eligible Retry button. Manual fallback always available.

nodes.title: Voice — second failure terminal
nodes.summary: Retry is exhausted. Third capture is prohibited within this session.

nodes.title: Voice — artist not found
nodes.summary: No best-guess artist, no ineligible STT Retry.

nodes.title: Voice — unsupported command
nodes.summary: Unsupported intents never execute by approximation.

nodes.title: Voice — unknown utterance
nodes.summary: Do not invent a missing intent or an extra interview.

nodes.title: Voice — provider unavailable
nodes.summary: Manual only. No forced Settings/cloud consent inside Driving.

nodes.title: Voice — microphone access denied
nodes.summary: No simulated Android mic dialog inside active Driving.

nodes.title: Voice — command rejected
nodes.summary: No false Executed, no ineligible Retry.

nodes.title: Settings / Privacy
nodes.summary: Existing non-driving privacy and permission surfaces; no cloud STT assumed enabled.

nodes.title: Privacy details
nodes.summary: Raw audio not stored by default. Consent must remain explicit and outside Driving.

nodes.title: Optional cloud voice consent
nodes.summary: Provider-specific remote STT stays disabled until separate legal/privacy acceptance.

nodes.title: Route / focus Android event
nodes.summary: Phone, call, headset and route callbacks belong to Android + Playback Service.

nodes.title: Route disconnected: Safe Paused
nodes.summary: No audio leaks to speaker and no automatic resume on reconnect.

nodes.title: Android route-reconnect handoff
nodes.summary: Platform owns the reconnection event. It must not auto-resume service playback.

edges.label: Route valid; return to app Safe Paused

nodes.title: Transient focus/call interruption
nodes.summary: Service policy-owned pause; guard evaluation must use real state.

edges.label: A resume guard fails: stay Safe Paused

nodes.title: Safe Paused — guard failed
nodes.summary: Manual playback survives, but unsafe playback is never auto-resumed.

edges.label: Explicit Play on revalidated safe route

nodes.title: Explicit user Resume pending
nodes.summary: Request Play only on valid route; awaiting service acknowledgement.

edges.label: Service confirms playback on safe route
